page.overview:
Who is Donquixote Mjosgard?

Saint Donquixote Mjosgard was a World Noble and member of the Donquixote Family, one of the 20 royal families that founded the World Government.

After an attempt to recapture his freed fish-man slaves went awry, Mjosgard met Queen Otohime of Fish-Man Island's Ryugu Kingdom and became their ally and a supporter of their efforts to integrate with humans, opposing the extreme racism typically associated with the World Nobles' normal ideology. During the most recent Levely, he would directly oppose other World Nobles from threatening Otohime's family, which resulted in his execution.

Mjosgard had his dark green hair styled in an updo, a hairstyle shared by most other World Nobles. He had a wide face with a bulbous nose that had snot hanging out from time to time, thick lips, and small slit-like eyes. He had his teeth laid bare (usually forming an arrogant grin) and one of his front teeth is missing. Like all World Nobles, he wore a thick white protective suit adorned with medal-like knobs and an air bubble when out in public. When he arrived on Fish-Man Island, he was shown bloody and injured after his journey.

After surviving his ordeal in Fish-man Island, his facial features became much less exaggerated. He appeared slimmer and his jawline became more angular, and he is seen with his mouth closed unless when talking. His face had facial hair, and his eyes appeared more blackish. He wore a simple, light purple collared shirt underneath his protective suit.
